name: [ORIGINALS] Vampire Town
desc:
Step into a mysterious, old-timey village where supernatural beings roam the streets and ancient secrets lurk in the shadows.

Choose your path: Vampire, Werewolf, Witch, or other supernatural species, each with their own unique powers and playstyle.
As you explore the whimsical town, complete quests, and battle enemies, you’ll level up, unlock new abilities, and upgrade your powers to become a true legend of the night.

⚔️ Buy weapons and craft your combat style.
🌟 Customize your build with a deep skill tree system.
🧭 Take on quests to earn rewards and uncover the town’s hidden lore.
🏰 Explore a beautifully designed world filled with magic, mystery, and danger.

Will you master your powers and rise above the rest, or become just another shadow in Vampire Town?
